outcome.outcome: A materials group with no quantum optics background can run an ultracold atom experiment. Techniques currently locked inside the labs that invented them spread to applied fields.
outcome.rationale: Their description asks precisely this: can these platforms be leveraged by people outside a small set of quantum physics labs.

ai_types.rationale: The blocker is standardisation, documentation and shared tooling norms, not a missing technical capability.
Turning bespoke apparatus into a reproducible instrument is hardware engineering with a manufacturability objective.

measurability.rationale: Count of groups outside the originating labs operating a standardised platform is a direct measure of the stated goal.

outcome.outcome: Turbulence gets predicted at engineering cost. That removes the largest single source of uncertainty in climate, aerospace and fusion modeling at once.
outcome.rationale: Turbulence is a shared upstream dependency, so the downstream unlock spans several fields at once.

ai_types.rationale: Learned closure models and flow surrogates are the active approach, with direct numerical simulation supplying exact training targets.

measurability.rationale: Prediction error against direct numerical simulation and experiment at a stated Reynolds number and compute budget is a direct benchmark.

outcome.outcome: Look inside a material at the nanoscale and trace its bulk behavior to the internal features that cause it.
outcome.rationale: Their description names understanding properties at the nanoscale as the loss from inadequate imaging.

ai_types.rationale: Neutron microscopy is flux-starved, and learned reconstruction from sparse counts is the standard route to usable resolution.

measurability.rationale: Achieved spatial resolution and contrast for a named material class are direct instrument specifications.

outcome.outcome: The question closes, either way, and stops absorbing attention.
outcome.rationale: Their description is careful that there is no good evidence but some parameter combinations remain underexplored; the unlock is resolution, not confirmation.

ai_types.rationale: Systematically sweeping an underexplored parameter space with consistent instrumentation is exactly what closed-loop experimentation is for.

measurability.rationale: Calorimetry can be performed and has been, but the field's history is that results are disputed rather than accepted, so no agreement exists that a given measurement settles the claim. Arguably tier 1 with sufficiently rigorous controls, which is why this is marked a guess.

outcome.outcome: High-energy beams on a benchtop. Accelerator-dependent research and medical isotope production stop queueing for facility time.
outcome.rationale: Their description names democratisation of high-energy physics and isotope production as the two unlocks.

ai_types.rationale: A benchtop accelerator is a hardware achievement; plasma wakefield approaches exist but must be built and made reliable.
Learned control and tuning of accelerator parameters already works and is not the constraint.

measurability.rationale: Beam energy per metre, achieved current and cost per GeV are direct and comparable across designs.

outcome.outcome: Quantum gravity gets an experimental constraint that the field agrees is one, and becomes a partly empirical subject.
outcome.rationale: The unlock is not any single measurement but the existence of a result the community treats as evidence.

ai_types.rationale: Their capability is targeted experiments, and the candidate designs require mesoscopic-mass interferometry hardware nobody has built.
Any such experiment would be limited by extracting a minute signal from overwhelming decoherence.

measurability.rationale: Candidate discriminators exist and are actively pursued, including gravitationally induced entanglement between mesoscopic masses, tabletop interferometry and Lorentz-invariance violation searches. What is contested is whether observing them would settle anything: there is live literature arguing gravity-mediated entanglement can be reproduced by classical gravitational fields, so reading it as proof requires further assumptions about local mediators. The blockage is the absence of agreement about what counts as a verdict, not the absence of an instrument.

outcome.outcome: Plasma stays confined for as long as the reactor needs, not as long as the instability allows. That is the last physics obstacle before sustained operation.
outcome.rationale: Their description names stable confinement as the major obstacle to practical fusion energy.

ai_types.rationale: Learned plasma control has been demonstrated on real tokamaks, and their own capability list leads with AI-driven control systems.
Magneto-inertial approaches require building confinement hardware that does not yet exist at the required performance.

measurability.rationale: Confinement time, energy gain factor and sustained stable duration are direct and universally reported fusion metrics.

outcome.outcome: A superconductivity claim can be settled in weeks. The current alternative is years of argument and a retraction.
outcome.rationale: Their capability is stated as conducting rigorous, non-fraudulent experiments, which makes adjudication the unlock rather than discovery.

ai_types.rationale: Their own single capability is literally to conduct rigorous, non-fraudulent experiments, which is a research-integrity and replication-norms problem, not a technique.
Automated, instrumented synthesis and measurement would remove the human discretion where irreproducibility and fraud enter.

measurability.rationale: Measurements have repeatedly been taken and repeatedly retracted; the field disputes which signature, resistance drop or Meissner expulsion under pressure, actually establishes superconductivity. The instrument is not the blocker, agreement about the verdict is.

notes: Physics carries three of the map's tier-3 calls, including quantum gravity, which is the sharpest instance of verifier's law available. Note the pattern: two of the three tier-3 gaps take an institutional or integrity primary, because when nobody agrees what settles a question, the binding constraint moves from the instrument to the community.
